title: core: TypeScript/JavaScript analyzer (variables, CFG, types, use-sites)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W1]
Seats: INTEL-05, INTEL-06
Add crates/core/src/analyze/ts.rs filling the frozen crates/core/src/analysis.rs types for TypeScript/JavaScript (.ts .tsx .js .jsx .mjs .cjs) via tree-sitter-typescript (+ tree-sitter-javascript for .js). Same output shape as INTEL-2/INTEL-3: variables (let/const/var, function params, class fields, top-level globals) with reads/writes and scope; FunctionCfg per function/arrow (if/else, for/while/do, switch, try/catch, ternary where sensible, return) with cyclomatic = decisions+1 and max_nesting; TypeNode for class/interface (fields + methods + doc) and type aliases/enums best-effort; TypeEdges (Field containment, Impl for `implements`/method owners, Inherit for `extends`, Variant); UseSites with kind Call|TypeRef|FieldAccess|VarRead|VarWrite. Reuse analyze/mod.rs shared helpers from INTEL-2 (import them; do not duplicate). Register the new language in the analyze/mod.rs dispatch (that one file is shared: coordinate via the card, keep the edit minimal). Owner: crates/core/src/analyze/ts.rs (+ one dispatch line in analyze/mod.rs). Depends: BLD-2 (grammar crates added to crates/core/Cargo.toml) and INTEL-2 (analyze/mod.rs helpers). Do not start until BLD-2 reports the pinned versions; report blocked otherwise. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core (inline test on a small .ts snippet: if/else+loop -> cyclomatic, a class with fields/methods -> TypeNode, an unused variable detected).

EVIDENCE:
Implemented crates/core/src/analyze/ts.rs only (no other file changed; analyze/mod.rs already dispatched TS/JS to ts::analyze).
All four parts done:
1. Variables: let/const/var declarators (multi-declarator + destructuring), params (TS required/optional_parameter, JS bare patterns, arrow single param), class fields (VarKind::Field), top-level => VarKind::Global; type_name only from an explicit annotation; reads/writes/first_use/last_use counted from identifier uses inside scope (declaration name excluded); enclosing via the shared helper.
2. CFG: one FunctionCfg per function_declaration/generator/method/named arrow/named function-expression; anonymous callbacks are FOLDED into the enclosing function. Nodes Entry/Block/Branch/Loop/Match/Call/Return/Exit; edges Normal/True/False/Back; cyclomatic = decisions + 1 (if, for/for-in/while/do, case arms, ?:, &&/||/??, catch); max_nesting; labels carry real source text (condition/header/call name).
3. Types: class/abstract class => Class; interface => Interface (fields + methods + JSDoc/line-comment doc); enum => Enum (members as Fields); type_alias => Struct (TypeKind has no Alias variant; best-effort, documented). TypeEdges: Inherit (extends / interface extends / alias target), Impl (implements), Field (field annotated with a declared type, resolved after the walk).
4. UseSites: Call (call_expression + new_expression), TypeRef (type_identifier), FieldAccess (member_expression property), VarRead/VarWrite (identifier loads/stores; target resolves to Variable::id when in scope, else the name); 1-based line/col, snippet via the shared helper.
Decisions recorded: anonymous callbacks folded into the enclosing CFG; enum Variant edges NOT modelled (members are Fields with empty type).
Implementation note: one parser per file + a recursive walk (not queries) because CFG construction is structural; set_language/parse failure returns early, never panics. Grammar by extension: .tsx => LANGUAGE_TSX; .js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs => tree_sitter_javascript; otherwise LANGUAGE_TYPESCRIPT.
Commands/results:
  cargo fmt --all -- --check -> exit 0
  cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0
  cargo test -p repowalk-core -> 115 lib tests passed, 0 failed (7 are analyze::ts) + integration: grammar_abi 4, contract 6, export_emitters 10, golden 1, walk_metrics 2, analysis_golden 3, zz_scratch_counts 1; 0 failed.
Counts on a small scratch.ts (class Point with ctor + move(if/else + for call); const origin: Point; const unused): variables=8, cfgs=2, types=1, type_edges=0, uses=20 (calls=2, field=5, typeref=2, varread=8, varwrite=3). move CFG nodes=10 edges=11 cyclomatic=3 max_nesting=1 back_edges=1; ctor cyclomatic=1; unused reads=0 writes=0; origin type=Some("Point").
Blocker: none.

EVIDENCE (follow-up: VER-2 golden caught the declaration-write contract):
Defect: the declaration name was excluded entirely from read/write counts, so a `const unusedTag = "dead";` had (reads=0, writes=0). INTEL-2 (Rust) and INTEL-3 (Python) count a declaration as exactly ONE write; the TS analyzer now matches.
Fix (crates/core/src/analyze/ts.rs only): VarRec gains `count_decl_write`; `push_var` seeds `writes = 1` for `let`/`const`/`var` bindings (multi-declarator + destructuring => one write per bound name) and class fields, and `0` for function parameters (params stay writes=0, matching the Rust/Python goldens). The declaration write does not set first_use/last_use, so an unused const keeps first_use=None. Secondary real bug fixed: `ident_role` treated ANY identifier under `augmented_assignment_expression` as read+write, including the RHS operand (e.g. `this.x += dx` counted `dx` as a write, `p += a` counted `a`); now only the LHS is read+write, the RHS is a plain read.
Inline regression tests added: `declaration_write_contract_across_shapes` (multi-declarator/destructuring = 1 write each, param = 0 decl write, augmented RHS is a read) and stronger asserts in `used_and_unused_variables` / `class_fields_and_methods`.
Before/after: unusedTag (0,0) -> (0,1); positives (3,2) -> (3,3).
Commands/results:
  cargo test -p repowalk-core --test analysis_golden -- --ignored golden_ts -> 3 passed, 0 failed (golden_ts_variables, golden_ts_cfg, golden_ts_types)
  cargo test -p repowalk-core --lib analyze::ts -> 8 passed, 0 failed
  cargo test -p repowalk-core -> 145 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored
  cargo fmt --all -- --check -> exit 0
  cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings -> exit 0
Contract now matches Rust/Python: declaration = 1 write, params = 0 writes.
